ja: • 龍装　劉備・鬼牙装　関羽・雷装　張飛の三位一体セット。 ■真龍帝剣の覚醒は、金メッキで再現。 ■必殺技「三位一体星龍斬」を繰り出す際のエフェクトパーツと、オリジナルの台座が付属
en: • Trinity set of dragon armor, Liu Bei, demon fangs, Guan Yu, thunder armor, and Zhang Fei. ■The awakening of the Shinryutei sword is reproduced with gold plating. ■Effect parts for performing the special move "Trinity Star Dragon Slash" and an original pedestal are included.
